# dltHub migration and recovery implementation workshare

## Proposed engagement

**Proposed fixed fee: USD 7,800. Proposed delivery: 12 business days after access and input acceptance.**

This is our implementation proposal, not a customer commitment, accepted purchase or statement of payment. No earlier company offer is replaced. Scope and commercial acceptance should be confirmed in the original company conversation.

The deliverable is a complete editable application that lets an implementation team retain a source edition, review its native dlt resource configuration, execute original pipeline stages, compare the complete target against independent expected data, and hand the resulting application and pipeline state to another operator.

## Customer outcome

A customer migration becomes an inspectable operating workflow. Each change retains the source, plan, runtime, complete native pipeline state, target database, observations and review. The receiving operator can inspect all earlier decisions and obtain the exact older named package. Runtime receiving rebuilds the selected private environment offline from the original source and retained cache; it verifies the same normalized installed identity.

The delivered reference demonstrates the process on original public inputs. Adapting it to a customer source requires their full input, schema/key/cursor decisions, independent expected data and a selected destination boundary.

## Five delivery phases

| Phase | Business days | Concrete result |
|---|---:|---|
| Intake and mapping | 2 | Retained customer source/configuration, primary keys, cursor semantics, field types, schema contract and complete acceptance table definitions. |
| Native pipeline integration | 3 | Original pinned dlt runtime, stage controls, retained load packages, closed target/state custody and explicit recovery. |
| Parity and migration review | 3 | Complete typed comparisons, incremental replay/backfill, nested-table coverage and reviewed consumer cutover/rollback. |
| Operator and receiving | 2 | Authenticated interface, CLI/API, full editable handoff, offline runtime receiving and older/forward history reopening. |
| Acceptance and delivery | 2 | One agreed full native programme, output review, operating notes and customer handover. |

The total is 12 business days. Work can overlap after its actual input dependencies are satisfied.

## Payment proposal

- USD 3,900 at scope and input acceptance.
- USD 3,900 when the agreed complete programme and editable handoff are delivered.

External hosting, metered services and customer production infrastructure remain separately authorized customer costs. This proposal does not require a paid SaaS plan or a hosted CI run.

## Included adaptation boundary

One customer migration workstream; up to three source resources and their agreed normalized child-table mappings; one original DuckDB receiving reference; one retained consumer binding; one operator deployment on a supported Linux host; one completed source/incremental/recovery/receiving acceptance programme.

The software can retain additional resources, but workload size, production connector credentials, destination-specific operational policy and additional integrations are priced after the real intake. Retained CSV/JSON/NDJSON are directly supported. A customer's live API/database extractor uses its original connector and needs explicit integration; a configuration review by itself is not an implemented connector.

## Acceptance

Acceptance requires actual results from the selected runtime and source. Every selected business table must have independent full expected rows; exact row multiplicities, primary-key validity and compatible schemas must pass. Pending packages, failed non-aborted jobs or unmapped normalized tables keep cutover blocked.

The customer receives complete editable source, original input provenance, runtime receiving material, native pipeline and destination state, original command/attempt receipts, full observations, browser evidence, current and older named handoffs, and operating instructions. A public reference result is evidence for that reference only; customer parity is observed using customer-approved data.

## Operating and recovery terms

The application owns only its private job directories and retained consumer binding. It never silently starts an unknown extraction again. The original job or package is reconciled through retained receipts, an explicit retry/adopt/abandon decision, or the native abort API. Selecting an older closed state creates an explicit continuation while keeping later history intact.

Production cutover, external application rewiring and credential authority remain with the existing customer owner. Any further company relationship correspondence follows the original company thread and designated human owner.
